description: This script includes functions for managing firmware upgrades on Ubiquiti devices, specifically for handling kernel flags and platform upgrades related to the ERX model. It interacts with device-specific partitions, manages UBI volumes, and performs low-level memory operations.

methods.name: ubnt_update_kernel_flag
methods.description: Updates the kernel boot index in the device's factory partition to ensure booting from the correct kernel slot.

methods.name: platform_upgrade_ubnt_erx
methods.description: Performs a platform upgrade on Ubiquiti ERX devices, managing the factory partition, UBI volumes, and calling the kernel flag update.
